about: Golden vectors for the codec, written by js/scripts/gen-vectors.js. See SPEC.md "Test vectors" for how to consume them.

schemas.name: boolean
schemas.about: A boolean is one bit in a bit byte; a lone boolean is one byte. Unused bits must be zero; nothing may follow the message.

schemas.name: bit-byte layout
schemas.about: Bit fields share one stream-wide bit byte, LSB first; a field that does not fit in the remaining bits opens a new bit byte at the next byte position. Byte-aligned values never move.

decode_refusals.name: unused bits in the first bit byte
unused bits in the last bit byte

schemas.name: int8 and uint8
schemas.about: int8 and uint8 are one raw byte (int8 in two's complement).

schemas.name: uint16
schemas.about: Unsigned LEB128 varint, at most 3 bytes, value < 2^16.

schemas.name: int16
schemas.about: Zigzag LEB128 varint, at most 3 bytes, zigzag value < 2^16.

schemas.name: uint32
schemas.about: Unsigned LEB128 varint, at most 5 bytes, value < 2^32.

schemas.name: int32
schemas.about: Zigzag LEB128 varint, at most 5 bytes.

schemas.name: uint64
schemas.about: Unsigned LEB128 varint, at most 10 bytes, value < 2^64. A JS number holds every integer up to 2^53 and some beyond; JS refuses to decode the others (precision).

schemas.name: int64
schemas.about: Zigzag LEB128 varint, at most 10 bytes.

schemas.name: integer default
schemas.about: An integer without format is int64: the same canonical form and descriptor.

schemas.name: floats
schemas.about: float and double are raw IEEE 754 binary32/binary64, little-endian. Every value is encoded, including infinities and NaN (written as the canonical quiet NaN). A double given for a float is rounded to the nearest binary32, ties to even (Math.fround).

cases.name: double 0.1 rounds to the nearest float
double 6.4 rounds to the nearest float

schemas.name: number default
schemas.about: A number without format is double.

schemas.name: strings
schemas.about: Length in bytes (unsigned varint, < 2^32) then UTF-8, strictly validated on decode.

schemas.name: bytes
schemas.about: contentEncoding base64 marks a byte string: length (unsigned varint) then raw bytes. In vectors a byte string is written as hex.

schemas.name: enums
schemas.about: Index in bitLength(n - 1) bits of the bit byte; a const takes 0 bits.

schemas.name: enum of 256
schemas.about: The largest enum: an 8-bit index, a whole bit byte.

schemas.name: objects
schemas.about: Fields in declared order; an optional field is preceded by its presence bit (1 = present).

schemas.name: presence bits across bytes
schemas.about: Ten optional booleans: presence and value bits fill bit bytes in order.

schemas.name: empty object
schemas.about: Zero bits: the message is zero bytes long.

schemas.name: const root
schemas.about: A single-value enum at the root: zero bytes.

schemas.name: arrays
schemas.about: Length (unsigned varint, < 2^32) then the items. minItems/maxItems are ignored.

schemas.name: array of booleans
schemas.about: Items that are bit fields pack into bit bytes after the length.

schemas.name: array of objects
schemas.about: Each item is a full object; its presence bits continue the current bit byte.

schemas.name: unions
schemas.about: oneOf with a tag property: branch index in bitLength(n - 1) bits of the bit byte, then the branch as an object without the tag. Decoded with the tag first.

cases.name: property of another branch is ignored

decode_refusals.name: nested B with its varint missing

schemas.name: union of three
schemas.about: Three branches in 2 bits: index 3 is invalid.

schemas.name: union of one
schemas.about: A single branch: 0 index bits.

schemas.name: deepest nesting
schemas.about: 31 nested arrays around a boolean: depth 32, the limit.
